title: identity.member.invite_revoked.v1
description: An owner or admin revoked a pending invitation (synthwerk#37). Written for every revoke, also for an email of a user of another org. CloudEvents subject: the invitation id. The orgid extension holds org_id. actor: user:<sub> of the owner or admin. No email, no subject id of the invitee.

role.description: Org role of the revoked invitation.
